lines.en: label saraspring3:
scene saraflashbacktime1
: Instead, I’ll just sit here and hope that absorbing all of that information is not currently and discreetly rotting me from the inside out.
lines.zh: : 那么，我就坐在这儿，指望消化掉那些信息不会正悄无声息地把我从里到外腐蚀掉。

lines.en: : Which I think it is.
lines.zh: : 我觉得会的。

lines.en: : Yup. It definitely is.
lines.zh: : 嗯。绝对在腐蚀。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime2
I’m probably just overreacting.
lines.zh: 我大概只是反应过度了。

lines.en: Sana’s only doing what makes her happy.
lines.zh: Sana 只是在做让她开心的事。

lines.en: And if I need to suffer for that to be the case, then so be it.
lines.zh: 而如果为此我必须受苦，那就受着吧。

lines.en: This is what I signed up for when I was her age. And thinking I can just back out of it now that I’ve seen what it’s like on film is dumber than thinking I can manage a place like this alone.
lines.zh: 我在她这个年纪的时候就签下了这份契约。而以为自己看过胶片上的样子就能临阵脱逃，那比以为自己能独自经营这种地方还要蠢。

lines.en: Though it’s {i}not{/i} as dumb as thinking I could raise children alone. {i}That{/i} is my crowning achievement.
lines.zh: 不过再蠢也蠢不过以为自己能独自把孩子拉扯大。{i}那{/i}是我的巅峰之作。

lines.en: And the trophy I’ve earned from my failure now turns itself into a shadow and hangs over my head, whispering into my ear whenever I try to sleep.
lines.zh: 而我从失败中赢得的那座奖杯，如今化作一片阴影悬在我头顶，每当我试图入睡，就在我耳边低语。

lines.en: At least that voice isn’t beckoning me closer to depravity, though.
lines.zh: 至少那个声音没有在引诱我继续堕落。

lines.en: I guess this is what I get for looking into the mirror too long.
lines.zh: 我想，这就是盯着镜子看太久的下场。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime3
: Aaah! Aaah! Harder! Harder, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 啊啊！啊啊！更用力！更用力，Sensei！

lines.en: I wonder if she does it as much as we did.
lines.zh: 我在想，她是不是做得跟我们一样多。

lines.en: I wonder what her favorite positions are.
lines.zh: 我在想她最喜欢什么姿势。

lines.en: If Sensei is gentle with her.
lines.zh: Sensei 对她是不是很温柔。

lines.en: If she ever {i}wants{/i} him to be or if she’s even more like me in thinking that’s just never enough.
lines.zh: 她会不会{i}希望{/i}他温柔些，还是说她比我更甚，觉得那样根本不够。

lines.en: It’s weird, you know?
lines.zh: 很奇怪吧？

lines.en: Because, on one hand, I’m scared. The way any mother would be.
lines.zh: 因为一方面，我害怕。任何母亲都会害怕。

lines.en: But on the other, there’s this strange sense of...{i}pride{/i} that I don’t really know how to put into words.
lines.zh: 可另一方面，又有一种奇怪的……{i}自豪感{/i}，我真的不知道该怎么说出口。

lines.en: I’ve heard something before. About mimicry being close to flattery. I can’t really remember if those are the exact words, but I think they are.
lines.zh: 我以前听过一句话。说模仿是最接近的恭维。我不太记得原话是不是这么说的，但我觉得是。

lines.en: Is her doing exactly what I did just a twisted way of showing me she {i}doesn’t{/i} think I’m a failure?
lines.zh: 她做着我做过的事，会不会只是一种扭曲的方式，用来告诉我她{i}并不{/i}觉得我是个失败者？

lines.en: Is wanting to include me {i}more{/i} than the worst case scenario of her thinking so little of me that I’d come without question?...
lines.zh: 想把我拉进来，会不会比「她把我看得太低贱、召之即来」这种最坏的情况{i}要好{/i}？……

lines.en: I have so many things I want to ask her, but lack the courage to ask any of it at all.
lines.zh: 我有太多事想问她，却连一件都没有勇气问出口。

lines.en: There’s one thing I’ve learned for sure, though.
lines.zh: 不过有一件事我是确定了的。

lines.en: : You gonna cum for me, baby? Again? How many times is that now?
lines.zh: : 要为我射了吗，宝贝？又来？这是第几次了？

lines.en: : Ah! Ah! I don’t know! Not...enough, though! Harder! Please!
lines.zh: : 啊！啊！我不知道！不过还……不够！更用力！求你了！

lines.en: It’s that this goes deeper than just being starved for attention — because I have given her all I have.
lines.zh: 那就是：这比单纯的渴望关注要深得多——因为我已经把我拥有的一切都给了她。

lines.en: And that was infinitely more than I ever received from anyone but {b}him.{/b}
lines.zh: 而那已经远比除{b}他{/b}以外任何人给过我的要多得多。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime4

lines.zh: : 嗯唔……操，Sara……都这么久了，你怎么还是这么紧？

lines.zh: : 因为我只是个小女孩……要是让他们看到你对我做了什么，他们会把你关一辈子的，Sensei……而他们会因为我……太享受而把我绑上火刑柱烧死！

lines.en: It was always me who talked him into finishing inside.
lines.zh: 一直都是我说服他射在里面的。

lines.en: And while it wasn’t like I was {i}trying{/i} to get pregnant, I wasn’t exactly against it either.
lines.zh: 虽然我并不是{i}想{/i}怀孕，但我也并不怎么反对。

lines.en: I just wanted something — {i}anything{/i} to make me feel like I had some sort of purpose. Which is probably why I jumped at the fact that someone looked at me the way he did.
lines.zh: 我只是想要某种东西——{i}任何{/i}能让我觉得我还算有点用的东西。这大概就是为什么一有人像他那样看我，我就扑了上去。

lines.en: This is where we’d meet most often. So if I {i}had{/i} taken Sana’s invite, I’d have felt right at home.
lines.zh: 这里是我们最常碰头的地方。所以如果我答应了 Sana 的邀请，我会觉得宾至如归。

lines.en: And if the drab decor mixed with those scents of sex and lotions and stale cigarette smoke didn’t do it for me, the arms of someone larger and stronger would have.
lines.zh: 而要是那些单调的装潢混着性爱、乳液和陈年烟味的气味还不足以让我自在，那一双更大更强的臂膀也会。

lines.en: But even when he had me pinned down by my shoulders, I never felt like I was trapped. I felt like I was safe.
lines.zh: 可即使他把我的肩膀按在地上，我也从不觉得被困住。我觉得很安全。

lines.en: Does Sana feel that way too?
lines.zh: Sana 也是这种感觉吗？

lines.en: Protected in the arms of someone she trusts more than me?
lines.zh: 在一个她比我更信任的人怀里，感到被保护？

lines.en: Would I know the answer by gazing into the mirror once more while the man I pledged myself to {i}this{/i} time moves in and out of her so deeply that I can see it sliding around beneath her skin?
lines.zh: 如果我再次凝视镜子，是否会知道答案——当{i}这次{/i}我以身相许的男人在她体内进进出出，深到我能看见那东西在她皮肤下滑来滑去？

lines.en: scene black
My shame is infinite.
lines.zh: 我的羞耻无边无际。

lines.en: My mother, in all her vicious splendor, would have puked if she saw my eyes roll to the back of my head from the ministrations of a man like him.
lines.zh: 我母亲，以她那恶毒的光辉，若是看到我被这样一个男人摆弄得翻白眼，怕是要吐出来。

lines.en: Meanwhile, if I were to see {i}my{/i} daughter at the height of her ecstasy...
lines.zh: 而与此同时，如果我看到{i}我{/i}女儿处在极乐的顶点……

lines.en: I think I’d just be happy knowing there is {i}something{/i} that makes her feel alive.
lines.zh: 我想我只会感到高兴，因为知道有{i}某样东西{/i}让她觉得自己还活着。

lines.en: And for the very first time...
lines.zh: 而且有生以来第一次……

lines.en: It is something we have in common.
lines.zh: 这是我们共同拥有的东西。

lines.en: It is something we can share.
lines.zh: 这是我们分享的东西。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime6
After he and I finished our rendezvous, we’d shower together and he’d send me on my way.
lines.zh: 等我和他缠绵完之后，我们会一起洗澡，然后他就会打发我走。

lines.en: I was supposed to be back by 10:00 on weeknights or my father would hit me.
lines.zh: 工作日我本该在十点前到家，不然我父亲会打我。

lines.en: I felt like it was worth it sometimes. Especially the week before my period when my hormones started ramping up and turning me into a borderline nymphomaniac.
lines.zh: 有时候我觉得值。尤其是月经前那一周，荷尔蒙开始飙升，把我变成个准性瘾者。

lines.en: I imagine it would have been hell without someone for me to spend all of that energy on. And how lucky I was that he was {i}always{/i} willing to help.
lines.zh: 我想，要是没有一个人让我把那些精力都花掉，那日子肯定是地狱。而我多幸运，他{i}总是{/i}乐于帮忙。

lines.en: The walk back was always a little awkward, though.
lines.zh: 不过回去的那段路总是有点尴尬。

lines.en: Things were livelier back then. Back when men were still {i}here{/i} and not zillions of miles away.
lines.zh: 那时候还热闹些。那时候男人还在{i}这儿{/i}，而不是在几百万英里之外。

lines.en: I’d take the long way back through a stretch of food stalls and izakaya because I liked looking at all of the lights and hearing music bleed into the open air whenever a door would slide open.
lines.zh: 我会绕远路，穿过一整条小吃摊和居酒屋，因为我喜欢看那些灯光，喜欢听门一拉开就泻进夜色里的音乐。

lines.en: Or at least that’s what I told myself because it made me feel less guilty about trying to make people look at me.
lines.zh: 至少我是这么告诉自己的，因为这样能让我在试图引人注目时少一点负罪感。

lines.en: And they did. But despite me liking it and {i}wanting{/i} it, I’d never respond. Just smile and keep walking. Quicken my pace a little and take solace in the fact that I wasn’t yet a ghost.
lines.zh: 而他们也确实在看。可尽管我喜欢、也{i}想要{/i}，我从不回应。只是微笑，继续走。稍稍加快脚步，并从「我还不是个幽灵」这个事实里汲取安慰。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime7
I knew I could be at any moment, though.
lines.zh: 但我知道，我随时都可能变成幽灵。

lines.en: I blacked out a lot those years. Saw things. {i}Heard{/i} things.
lines.zh: 那些年我经常断片。看见东西。{i}听见{/i}东西。

lines.en: And all it would take for my life to come to an end was one poorly timed blackout in the immediate vicinity of {i}one{/i} bad person.
lines.zh: 而我的人生要终结，只需要一个不合时宜的断片，恰好发生在{i}一个{/i}坏人身边。

lines.en: It never happened.
lines.zh: 那从没发生过。

lines.en: And it wouldn’t be until years later that those unfortunate thoughts would manifest in the form of the single worst thing that has ever happened to me.
lines.zh: 而直到多年以后，那些不幸的念头才具象成有史以来发生在我身上最可怕的一件事。

lines.en: Just...it {i}didn’t{/i} happen to me.
lines.zh: 只是……那件事{i}没有{/i}发生在我身上。

lines.en: My son became a ghost in my place.
lines.zh: 我的儿子代替我成了幽灵。

lines.en: Now I struggle to even bring him up without everything around me shattering into a million pieces.
lines.zh: 如今我连提起他都困难，周围的一切都会碎成上百万片。

lines.en: Is this what I get for defying God?
lines.zh: 这就是我违抗上帝的下场吗？

lines.en: Should I have listened to the two-headed horse or that woman with blades for wings? Taken their offers in exchange for whatever it is they wanted from me?
lines.zh: 我当初是不是该听那个双头马、或者那个翅膀是刀的女人的话？用它们想要的东西，换下它们的提议？

lines.en: I often think so. Especially now that I don’t see them anymore.
lines.zh: 我常常这么想。尤其是现在我不常见到它们了。

lines.en: But back then, I had nothing to give.
lines.zh: 但那时候，我一无所有可以给。

lines.en: Why am I ignored now that I {i}do?{/i}
lines.zh: 为什么现在我{i}有得给了{/i}，却被无视？

lines.en: scene black
You probably think I’m crazy, don’t you? Always telling you things like this.
lines.zh: 你大概觉得我疯了吧？老跟你说这些。

lines.en: I’m sure it also doesn’t help to hear me musing about the way my lover touches my daughter when I should be getting between them instead.
lines.zh: 我确信，听到我在这儿琢磨我的情人怎么碰我女儿，而不是该插到他们中间去，也没什么帮助。

lines.en: But all I do is make mistakes, so it’s impossible to trust my judgement.
lines.zh: 可我做的只有犯错，所以我的判断根本不可信。

lines.en: Sana is safer with him than she is with me. But despite already making her choice, she’s kind enough to include {i}me{/i} as well.
lines.zh: Sana 跟他在一起比跟我在一起安全。但尽管她已经做出了选择，她还是好心地把{i}我{/i}算了进去。

lines.en: Worthless me.
lines.zh: 一无是处的我。

lines.en: Sickening me.
lines.zh: 令人作呕的我。

lines.en: {size=-2}Dreadful, nauseating, stupid, pitiful me! Who does nothing but cry and dredge up memories I {i}could{/i} erase but {i}don’t{/i} because I’m afraid of what will happen if I reach back to find them and come up empty-handed!{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}可怕、恶心、愚蠢、可悲的我！除了哭泣、除了翻搅那些我{i}本可以{/i}抹去却{i}不敢{/i}抹去的记忆，什么都不会——因为我害怕伸手去够，却两手空空！{/size}

lines.en: If you were real, would you hold me?
lines.zh: 如果你是真的，你会抱我吗？

lines.en: {i}Just{/i} me?
lines.zh: {i}只{/i}抱我一个？

lines.en: Or is there {i}no{/i} world in the trillions that exist where I, alone, am enough?
lines.zh: 还是在万亿个存在的世界里，就{i}没有{/i}一个世界，光是我一个人就足够了？

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime8
The apartment was different back then. My parents didn’t like to clean — and they’d often let the trash pile up until the place reeked of rotten food and old beer.
lines.zh: 那间公寓那时候和现在不同。我父母不爱打扫——垃圾常常堆到屋里弥漫着腐烂食物和陈啤酒的味道。

lines.en: Sometimes, I’d get sick of it and take it out myself. But most of the time, I just hid in my room or snuck into the movie theater to spend all of my time there.
lines.zh: 有时候我受够了就自己拿出去倒。但大多数时候，我只是躲在自己房间里，或者溜进电影院，把所有时间都耗在那儿。

lines.en: Well, the time I {i}wasn’t{/i} already spending beneath my teacher. Which was a good portion of it if my earlier recollection didn’t already clue you in on that.
lines.zh: 嗯，是我在老师身下{i}之外{/i}的时间。要是我前面的回忆还没让你看出来，那部分时间可占了不少。

lines.zh: : 你只是……看起来像……

lines.en: : Looked like what, Sara?! Is your big, bad father being {i}mean{/i} to his freeloading daughter again?! Are you scared of me?! After all I’ve fucking done for you?!
lines.zh: : 像什么，Sara？！是你那个又大又坏的爸爸又在{i}欺负{/i}他白吃白住的女儿了？！你怕我吗？！在我他妈为你做了这一切之后？！

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime16
: Yes! I {i}am!{/i} I’ve said it over and over and over again! But you’re always too fucking drunk to-
lines.zh: : 对！我{i}怕{/i}！我说了一遍又一遍又一遍！可你每次都他妈醉得——

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime17
: Ngh!
lines.zh: : 嗯啊！

lines.en: : Too fucking {i}what{/i} now?! You think I’m a drunk?! Is {i}that{/i} all I am to you?!
lines.zh: : 他妈的{i}什么{/i}？！你觉得我是酒鬼？！在你眼里我就只是{i}这个{/i}？！

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime18
: Let’s talk about you then, Sara! What have {i}you{/i} fucking contributed to this house apart from running up the fucking water bill and making it smell like- {i}sniff.{/i} What {i}is{/i} that?
lines.zh: : 那就说说{i}你{/i}吧，Sara！除了把水费他妈的刷上去、把屋子弄得闻起来像——{i}嗅{/i}。这{i}是{/i}什么味儿？

lines.en: : Not my face! Please!
lines.zh: : 别打我的脸！求你了！

lines.en: : She’s probably going through my perfume again. I noticed my No. 5 missing.
lines.zh: : 她大概又在翻我的香水。我发现我的 No.5 不见了。

lines.en: : {i}*Sniff*{/i} That’s exactly fucking it. It’s not enough to eat all of our fucking food, you’re stealing from your own fucking mother now?!
lines.zh: : {i}*嗅*{/i} 就是他妈的这个。光吃光我们的食物还不够，你现在还偷自己亲妈的东西？！

lines.en: : No! I didn’t steal anything! I’m wearing my own perfume! I don’t know what happened to-
lines.zh: : 没有！我什么都没偷！我喷的是自己的香水！我不知道怎么——

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime19
: YOU’RE CALLING {i}HER{/i} A LIAR NOW TOO?! WHEN DOES IT FUCKING END WITH YOU, SARA?!
lines.zh: : 你现在也说{i}她{/i}撒谎？！你他妈到底有完没完，SARA？！

lines.en: : NGHGH?!?!!!
: Don’t choke the girl, dear. Even {i}if{/i} she deserves it.
lines.zh: : 别掐她脖子，亲爱的。{i}就算{/i}她活该。

lines.en: : She can breathe. She’s just pretending she can’t because she wants you to feel bad for her. Woe is Sara. {i}Poor{/i} Sara. Her life is so fucking hard, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 她能呼吸。她只是装作不能呼吸，想让你心疼她。可怜的 Sara。{i}可怜的{/i} Sara。她活得可真他妈难啊，不是吗？

lines.en: : Ngckkk....nghhkkk! K...ngchchkkk!!!
lines.zh: : 呃咳咳……嗯呵咳咳！咳……呃咳咳咳！！！

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} actually think you’re choking her, dear.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的，我觉得你是{i}真的{/i}在掐她。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime20
: {b}{size=+5}HAAAAAAAAH! AAAAAH!{/b}{/size}
: Fucking drama queen. That was five seconds. {i}My{/i} dad used to strangle me until my face turned blue. You have any idea how {i}scared{/i} you’d be living under his roof?
lines.zh: : 他妈的戏精。才五秒钟。{i}我{/i}爸以前掐我脖子掐到脸发青。你知道活在他的屋檐下有多{i}害怕{/i}吗？

lines.en: : I’ll do the dishes! I’ll do them right now! I’ll be back by 10:00 from now on! I promise!
lines.zh: : 我洗碗！我现在就洗！从今往后我十点前回来！我保证！

lines.en: : You sure will. Because starting tomorrow, your curfew is changed to 9:00. {i}That{/i} way, you might actually make it home on time.
lines.zh: : 你当然会。因为从明天起，你的门禁改到九点。{i}这样{/i}你也许真能准时到家。

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime21
: But I-
lines.zh: : 可是我——

lines.en: : {i}But I{/i} don’t give a shit! You’ll do what we tell you or we’ll kick your ass to the street where you can learn what it’s {i}really{/i} like to be {i}scared.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可是{i}我才{/i}他妈不在乎！我们叫你做什么你就做什么，否则就把你踹到街上去，让你见识见识什么叫{i}真正{/i}的{i}害怕{/i}。

lines.en: : She wouldn’t last ten minutes out there with her thong out. Poor thing would be a meat toilet in less than twenty-four hours.
lines.zh: : 她穿着那条丁字裤在外面撑不了十分钟。可怜的东西，不出二十四小时就会变成个肉马桶。

lines.en: : Yeah, well at least then {i}someone{/i} would have a fucking use for her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那至少还有个他妈的用处。

lines.en: scene black
: Now, get in the fucking kitchen and pull your weight. And go right to sleep after that, you hear me?
lines.zh: : 现在，滚进那该死的厨房去尽你的本分。洗完就赶紧去睡，听见没有？

lines.en: scene saraflashbacktime1
I used to think I was a better parent than mine because {i}I{/i} never put my children through the Hell that {i}I{/i} was put through.
lines.zh: 我曾经以为我比我的父母更称职，因为{i}我{/i}从没让我的孩子经历{i}我{/i}经历过的那个地狱。

lines.en: But then one of them found it on accident.
lines.zh: 但后来其中一个孩子意外地找到了它。

lines.en: Now, I don’t think that much anymore.
lines.zh: 现在，我不太这么想了。

lines.en: I try not to think at all, really.
lines.zh: 其实，我尽量什么都不想。

lines.en: But you can see how well that’s working out since the two of {i}us{/i} are here now while I continue to delay the inevitable.
lines.zh: 但你能看到这招有多管用——既然{i}我们俩{/i}现在都在这儿，而我还在继续拖延那不可避免的事。

lines.en: This was over the moment she asked.
lines.zh: 她开口的那一刻，这就已经结束了。

lines.en: I would cut my belly open if she begged me to in earnest.
lines.zh: 如果她真心求我，我会把自己的肚子剖开。

lines.en: How lucky I am that she wants to keep me alive when I have done nothing to earn my place in her world.
lines.zh: 我是多么幸运，在我在她的世界里一无所值的时候，她还想让我活下去。

lines.en: That’s me.
lines.zh: 这就是我。

lines.en: Worthless me.
lines.zh: 一无是处的我。
